text:
No option can be put forward yet, because the model could not test your under‑4% monthly churn limit.

- The comparison itself was robust under the tested changes, but it rests on four Olumi-supplied inputs rather than recorded evidence: Pro subscriber count, other-plan MRR, monthly Pro conversions and monthly churn.
- The 4% limit remains unscored: the model treats churn as calculated from other factors rather than as a comparable observed monthly rate.
- The result also assumes that higher MRR is the objective; that direction was not explicitly recorded.

The key unresolved reasoning step is to define which measured churn rate the 4% limit applies to.
